title: Measures to Reduce Number of Fire and Gas Leakage Cases in Hawker and Food Centres
what_it_is: Measures to Reduce Number of Fire and Gas Leakage Cases in Hawker and Food Centres

sections.label: Fire safety and gas rules
sections.summary: Hawker centres follow SCDF fire safety rules, with fire provisions installed and LPG cylinders stored outside under approved manifold systems.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Fire safety and gas supply in our hawker centres are subject to the Singapore Civil Defence Force’s (SCDF) prevailing regulations and Fire Code requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Hawker centres are installed with fire safety provisions such as manual fire alarms, heat/smoke detectors, fire extinguishers and fire hose reels.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: SCDF’s Fire Code requires liquefied petroleum gas, or LPG, cylinders within the allowable capacity, to be stored at ground level outside the hawker centre, at a well-ventilated area where any potential gas leakage can be safely and rapidly dispersed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: To help prevent gas leakage and minimise fire risk, the LPG manifold systems have to be designed by a Qualified Person and approved by SCDF.

sections.label: NEA review of suggested system
sections.summary: NEA will review the suggested system, considering its purpose and practicality, especially during emergencies.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: NEA will review the suggestion, considering the purpose as well as practicality of such a system as suggested by the Member, especially during emergencies.

sections.label: Stall fire incidents and prevention
sections.summary: From 2019 to 2021 there were 31 stall fires, mostly from unattended cooking, and authorities urge stallholders to prevent fires.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: In fact, over the last three years, between 2019 and 2021, there was a total of 31 stall fire incidents at hawker centres, and the majority of these – 22 or about 71% – were due to unattended cooking, and four were due to either faulty appliances or power supply overloading.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, indeed, as the authorities, the agencies and the partners, the supplier of the LPG gas or town gas, we will do our part to ensure that the infrastructure at the hawker centres is safe and sound, want to urge the stallholders to exercise personal responsibility in preventing stall fires.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, for instance, not to leave cooking unattended, to make sure there is no power supply overload, check for faulty appliances.
